block_readings.visual_reading: Widespread separate cloud/shadow pairs cover parts of the frame. Six of12 southern-edge centres have cloud/edge/shadow visibility uncertainty;9619 and9622–9626 show wave-textured marine surface between them. SCL6 does not overrule visible cloud-edge/shadow problems.
Both centres are unresolved for visibility:9615 lies on the northeastern cloud mass,9616 near the southern-left cloudy edge. Neither is accepted from the valid masks or the latter SCL6 label.

The marked chain runs from northern clouds/shadows onto the reef and then seaward.9630/9631/9634/9636 retain exact atmospheric visibility questions. Eighteen reef/inner-margin centres retain exposure/mixing questions. The remaining14 centres are visibly on marine surface, including9645 in blue lagoon context and9654/9657–9664 seaward.
The only centre9665 lies northeast of the reef in continuous visible wave-textured water, between separate cloud/shadow pairs; no cloud or exposed reef covers the marked centre.
